npcs.name: Elior Zalmar
npcs.title: Lost Architect of the Flood
npcs.role: Tartarian philosopher-scientist whose Etheric Engine experiments at Thametan's Tower triggered the Great Mud Flood.
npcs.summary: Spoken of in Forgotten Order debates as both visionary and cautionary tale. Some say his notes survive in Voronov.

npcs.name: Professor Harlan Moore
npcs.title: Tartarian Historian
npcs.role: Historian obsessed with uncovering Tartaria's secrets — willing to betray allies if it brings him closer to lost knowledge.
npcs.summary: Often pays handsomely for relic translations. Trust him with maps, not with friends.

npcs.name: Sasha Ironheart
npcs.title: Leader of the Tartarian Revivalists
npcs.role: Believes reviving the Tartarian Giants could be humanity's salvation. Formidable, occasionally dangerous.
npcs.summary: Recruits openly among True Tartarian sympathizers. Her dedication can pull a whole town under.

npcs.name: Drake Volkov
npcs.title: Mercenary
npcs.role: Seasoned mercenary hired to protect Tartarian expeditions. Murky past, loyalty for hire.
npcs.summary: If you can outbid the last contract, he's your shield. If not, he's the spear.

npcs.name: Ivy Solis
npcs.title: Treasure Hunter
npcs.role: Reclaimer fascinated by Tartarian relics; loyalty driven by the value of the find.
npcs.summary: Will partner on a dive if the cut is fair. Will walk if a richer one opens up.

npcs.name: Dr. Lucius Kincaid
npcs.title: Reclusive Patron
npcs.role: Enigmatic sponsor of expeditions — supplies ancient maps and resources to those willing to seek Tartaria's lost secrets.
npcs.summary: His true motives stay hidden. The maps work. The bills always come due.

npcs.name: Varakush
npcs.title: Warden of the Forgotten Order
npcs.role: Steward of the Forgotten Order's hidden base on the edge of the Great Tartary Plains; gatekeeper for Order-quest contracts.
npcs.summary: Hands out the Order's relic-recovery contracts. Hard to impress, fair when impressed.

npcs.name: Speaker of the Grand Assembly
npcs.title: Reclaimers Guild Voice
npcs.role: The current public face of the Reclaimers' Grand Assembly — coordinates the haul market and posts Guild contracts.
npcs.summary: Rotates yearly. Whoever it is, they answer to the Assembly. Whoever it is, they don't pay extra.
